decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With the appropriate safeguarding conditions the approved extension would not harm the appearance of the area or neighbouring residents living conditions in accordance with adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and S.4.5 (Servicing Arrangements), of the Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the visual amenities of the area)

Condition : 3 - The extension shall be rendered in white or cream colouring or the extension be clad in brick work to match that of the existing premises.  These works shall be carried out within 3 months from the date of this permission and permanently retained.REASON:  These works are required so that the extension harmonises with the surroundings in the interests of the appearance and character of the area.

Condition : 4 - The extensions shall only be used ancillary to the main authorised use of the ground floor of the premises and not used as separate units.

REASON: To ensure that no independent uses commence for which there would be inadequate on site parking and servicing.
description: Retention of single storey rear extension incorporating external staircase to take-away premises.
